sdg.name: UN Sustainable Development Goals: targets bearing on fairness

5.1.name: End discrimination against women and girls
5.1.passage: End all forms of discrimination against all women and girls everywhere

5.2.name: Eliminate violence against women and girls
5.2.passage: Eliminate all forms of violence against all women and girls in the public and private spheres,

5.3.name: Eliminate child, early and forced marriage and FGM
5.3.passage: Eliminate all harmful practices, such as child, early and forced marriage and female genital mutilation

5.5.name: Women's participation and leadership
5.5.passage: Ensure women's full and effective participation and equal opportunities for leadership

5.6.name: Sexual and reproductive health and reproductive rights
5.6.passage: Ensure universal access to sexual and reproductive health and reproductive rights

5.a.name: Women's equal rights to economic resources and property
5.a.passage: Undertake reforms to give women equal rights to economic resources,

5.c.name: Policies and laws for gender equality
5.c.passage: Adopt and strengthen sound policies and enforceable legislation for the promotion of gender equality

8.5.name: Decent work and equal pay for work of equal value
8.5.passage: and equal pay for work of equal value

8.7.name: End forced labour, modern slavery, trafficking and child labour
8.7.passage: Take immediate and effective measures to eradicate forced labour, end modern slavery and human trafficking

8.8.name: Labour rights, including for migrant workers
8.8.passage: Protect labour rights and promote safe and secure working environments for all workers

10.2.name: Inclusion irrespective of age, sex, disability, race and other status
10.2.passage: irrespective of age, sex, disability, race, ethnicity, origin, religion or economic or other status

10.3.name: Equal opportunity and ending discriminatory laws
10.3.passage: Ensure equal opportunity and reduce inequalities of outcome, including by eliminating discriminatory

10.4.name: Fiscal, wage and social protection policies for equality
10.4.passage: Adopt policies, especially fiscal, wage and social protection policies, and progressively achieve greater equality

16.2.name: End abuse, exploitation and trafficking of children
16.2.passage: End abuse, exploitation, trafficking and all forms of violence against and torture of children

16.3.name: Rule of law and equal access to justice
16.3.passage: Promote the rule of law at the national and international levels and ensure equal access to justice for all

16.9.name: Legal identity for all, including birth registration
16.9.passage: By 2030, provide legal identity for all, including birth registration

16.10.name: Public access to information and fundamental freedoms
16.10.passage: Ensure public access to information and protect fundamental freedoms

16.b.name: Non-discriminatory laws and policies
16.b.passage: Promote and enforce non-discriminatory laws and policies for sustainable development
